# Plan: Nemotron-H Hybrid Inference on 12GB CUDA GPU

## 1. Architecture Analysis & Tensor Mapping

The Nemotron-H model (context: `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp`) supports **Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)** with shared experts and **Mamba2** recurrent layers. The target is to keep latency-sensitive tensors on a 12GB GPU while overflowing routed experts to CPU RAM.

### Critical Tensor Classification

| Category | Tensors | Size Estimate (per layer) | GPU/CPU Placement |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mamba2 SSM** | `ssm_in`, `ssm_conv1d`, `ssm_conv1d_b`, `ssm_dt_b`, `ssm_a`, `ssm_d`, `ssm_norm`, `ssm_out` | ~8-16 KB | **GPU** (latency critical; small, frequent access) |
| **Attention** | `attn_norm`, QKV weights (`create_tensor_qkv`), `wo`, `wo_b` | ~50-100 KB | **GPU** |
| **Routed MoE Experts** | `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps`, `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | **~200-500 KB** (per expert) | **CPU RAM** (overflow) |
| **Shared Experts** | `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | ~100 KB | **GPU** (hot; used every token) |
| **NextN/MTP Draft** | `nextn.*`, `attn_norm`, QKV, `ffn_*` (trailing blocks) | ~100 KB | **GPU** (drafting pipeline) |

### Code Path & Offloading Strategy

The loading logic in `load_arch_tensors` uses `trunk_flags` to mark non-essential tensors. We leverage `TENSOR_NOT_REQUIRED` to defer allocation and implement a custom offload step.
